narrative: In the account book. The narrow book is open at the payments. The canvas is gone. He writes one line and does not write a figure under it. The clove is on the table, finished. In the account book. No subtraction. No new total. The ruled £23 10s of Monday is not copied out again, and it is not amended.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the line, and did not do the subtraction.
